office.name: Wyoming Highway Patrol - Overweight Loads Office (OWL)

fees.note: Oversize permit $25 (Class A/B/C single trip, valid up to 4 days).
$0.03 per mile for each foot or fraction of width over 15 ft.
$0.03 per mile for each foot or fraction of height over 15 ft.

$0.06 per ton (or fraction) over the statutory limit per mile, $40 minimum. State uses the greatest excess (axle, group or gross); excess here is gross over 80,000, which understates it if an axle group is the larger overage and overstates it for configurations legal above 80,000 lb.
Over 125 tons (250,000 lb) or allowable weights: permittee pays all Department costs (route/structure analysis and personnel accompanying the move) before issuance.

police.text: 1 police escort. Department/WHP personnel may accompany loads over 125 tons; number set by OWL, cost billed to the permittee.

restrictions.text: Daylight only, except: up to 10 ft wide on Interstates only; combinations under 110 ft overall with a single unit over 60 ft; single units up to 75 ft (if signed and lighted); or with WHP permission. Overweight-only loads are not limited to daylight.

Moves requiring escorts: no travel on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, from 1/2 h after sunset the evening before to 1/2 h before sunrise the day after (whole 3-day weekend when the holiday adjoins a weekend), or during local celebrations.

Moves requiring escorts: no travel on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, from 1/2 h after sunset the evening before to 1/2 h before sunrise the day after (whole 3-day weekend when the holiday adjoins a weekend), or during local celebrations.

Moves requiring escorts: no travel on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, from 1/2 h after sunset the evening before to 1/2 h before sunrise the day after (whole 3-day weekend when the holiday adjoins a weekend), or during local celebrations.

Over 18 ft wide: no travel on primary/secondary highways during local school-bus or heavy commuter hours (set by OWL); 24 h advance notice for loads over 18 ft wide or high; over 26 ft wide not allowed on roads about 32 ft wide or less.
Weather: may be restricted on ice/snow; no movement when roads are 'no unnecessary travel' or chain law is in effect; wind-related closures for light, high-profile loads (Class 1-4 restrictions).

notes: Class B/C (routine) single-trip limits: 18 ft wide, 17 ft high, 120 ft overall, 25,000 single / 55,000 tandem / 65,000 triple axle, 160,000 lb gross. Beyond these is a Class A super load approved only by the OWL.
The rule also charges $0.03/ft/mile for single-unit length over 75 ft; not modeled here because input length is overall combination length - add manually for long single units.

Escort thresholds: 14 ft wide or 110 ft long on two-lane routes (1 front + 1 rear); 15 ft wide or 150 ft long on Interstate/divided (1 rear); 25 ft rear overhang (1 rear); over 17 ft high (front with height pole). Any part crossing the centerline on two-lane roads also needs front+rear. OWL may add escorts (and requires a rear escort for overweight moves with special restrictions).
Chapter 5 text cited is the 2024 revision as filed with the Legislature; confirm the adopted version on rules.wyo.gov.
Legal gross in WY is bridge-table based up to 117,000 lb; verify overweight status against axle configuration.
Oversize ($25 + mileage) and overweight ($0.06/ton-mile, $40 min) fees are listed separately in the rule and are added together when a load is both - verify with OWL.
